protocol_amendment.reason: All three independent V7 reviewers required revision before launch-plan design. They found an uncharged density-primary point enumeration, no validity-enforced actual-to-reservation dominance, unrestricted public direct-row semantics, late family-gate and nested integrity rejection, aggregate phases that could pass before all cells completed, loss of failing-cap work, amplifiable reflected and nested diagnostics, incomplete source-sized collection admission, and overstated secondary-objective independence outside frozen B4.
changes: Accept only the V8 document schema and reject V1-V7 without row verification.
Make path-based verify_document the sole evidence-bearing API and disable public legacy-row and density-row helpers before mathematical work.

Apply closed source key sets to every major document, row, and nested row object, plus source-sized family-gate, Mobius-map, alternating-position, rejection-reason, polynomial, formal, edge, source-table, graph/expansion-histogram, exact-frontier, and byte-receipt bounds before generic JSON traversal.
Authenticate nested curve, factor-base, representative, public-edge, source-table, frontier, and byte-accounting receipts before curve semantics.
Reconstruct and compare the document summary and family gate before resource reservation and row semantics.
Separate registered and frozen point-enumeration reservations and charge frozen, semantic, and density-primary enumeration calls before execution.
Globally charge replay and independent-primary nodes as explored, replay and primary cache entries as inserted, and retained-model cells as evaluated.
Treat global actual counters as authoritative, preserve failing-cap lower bounds on exceptions, and mark interrupted work incomplete.

Require actual_work_complete=true, source-owned actual-to-reservation dominance, and exact completed-path cache lookup/miss and frozen/semantic/primary enumeration counts as report-validity invariants.
Track expected, completed, and failed units for every aggregate curve, replay, retained-model, and primary phase; pass only when all registered units pass.

Sanitize reflected document digests, normalize nested diagnostics into the bounded top-level list, use bounded key sampling, and cap the complete serialized report including its integrity fields at 8 MiB.

Narrow canonical wording: the primary optimum is independently proved, while secondary objective fields are deterministic replay confirmations outside the structurally separate frozen-B4 complete oracle.

Add exact frozen actual-work and reservation assertions, direct-API zero-work controls, pre-traversal list and nested-dictionary amplification controls, nested-integrity and claim-preflight controls, phase-local and mid-function exception controls, point-enumeration failure and undercharge controls, under-reservation invalidation, digest sanitation, and complete-report ceiling controls.
Keep every development family-row and canonical run budget at zero.
unchanged_mathematical_boundary: The curve grid, predicates, four null replicates, representative compiler, ordering digest, graph object, cap schedule, five-field objective, matched-null thresholds, positive gate, and negative classification remain unchanged.
Exactness remains finite, TOY-EVIDENCE, and MODEL-BOUND to the fixed compiler and order-ideal construction.
No relation generation, rank, linear algebra, target descent, fixed-curve preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, deployment, or ECDLP result is in scope.
residual_external_resource_boundary: The source reservation is a combinatorial ceiling, not a runtime prediction or memory model.
JSON parser allocation, Python object overhead, allocator bytes, peak RSS, process count, wall time, disk, I/O, and memory bandwidth require a future immutable external runner.
The module-load verifier digest is diagnostic only; a future runner must bind the exact commit, command, environment, and immutable input/output paths.
protocol_amendment.required_next_review: Validate and commit one exact V8 snapshot, then obtain fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team review. Three scoped GO decisions could authorize only a separate hash-complete launch-plan design, not execution.
